description: Fixed priority-tier-to-action mapping for the lead-response agent. Same role as reasoning-core/playbook.json: single source of truth read by both the system prompt and the dashboard UI.

tiers.name: Critical — overdue, high-loss segment
trigger_signals: tier1 city and SUV interest, or a repeat/referral customer
tiers.action_description: Call the lead within the hour and offer a same-day test drive slot for their vehicle of interest.

tiers.name: High — overdue, standard segment
tiers.action_description: Contact via phone and SMS today, ahead of standard-priority leads.

tiers.name: Standard — within SLA window
tiers.action_description: Contact via the lead's preferred available channel within the expected response window.

tiers.name: Nurture — repeated attempts, no engagement
trigger_signals: contact_attempts is 2 or more with no test drive requested and no recent engagement
tiers.action_description: Move to a low-touch digital nurture sequence (email/SMS) rather than urgent outreach; re-engage promptly if interest signals increase.
